name: AK32D - Plug-In Combustible Gas Detector (Natural Gas, LPG, Temperature, Humidity), Kitchen Gas Leak Alarm
highlights: Watching for a Leak, Not for Comfort — This is the only configuration in the AK32 range aimed at combustible gas — natural gas and LPG — rather than air quality. Different job, same socket.
Sited Where the Gas Would Collect — A plug-in body lets you choose the socket nearest the hob, the boiler or the cylinder store, which is what makes the difference between early detection and late.
Continuous Mains Operation — No battery to go flat between the day it was installed and the day it is needed.
110–240 V, US and EU Pins — Two plug variants from one production line.
120 Per Carton — Same outer carton as the rest of the AK32 series.
